scope: Controlled functional A/B comparison: 180 scenario executions, not 180 individual model API calls. Real Main, Jev, child models and tools; captured channel transport; not a production traffic sample or independent semantic evaluation.

source_provenance.note: Primary measurements precede the later admission-state prompt fix and this offline analysis command. Measured tree also contained separate sandbox fixes left unmerged by this change. Hashes identify the measured files; the public checkout can rerun the experiment but is not the exact measured source snapshot.

measurement_contract.tokens: Main, Jev and child reported token usage are separate; cache inputs and reasoning outputs are already included, never add them twice. Missing usage is unknown, not known zero.
measurement_contract.first_visible_ms: First successful visible delivery from admission; null means no delivery. Can be a provisional response or erroneous refusal, not necessarily useful task progress.
measurement_contract.last_visible_ms: Last successful visible delivery, not semantic completion. A and B visible denominators differ.
measurement_contract.action_correct: Original finite automated action check. Known clarification regex false negatives are retained; not independently reviewed end-to-end action accuracy.
measurement_contract.task_completed: Original finite tool/state/artifact/output-fragment oracle; not independent semantic quality. Role completed can contain blocked; the oracle can miss that.
measurement_contract.cost: Counterfactual API-equivalent estimate using cached/noncached input and output. Not an invoice for subscription-backed CLIProxyAPI or the free Jev model. Exclude pre-request setup only; include setup-child continuations whose call.phase is request.
measurement_contract.paired_token_and_cost_population: Use only case_id/repeat pairs where both arms have valid setup, no request error/provider error/timeout, and complete Main/child and Jev usage. Keep all original observations in the artifact.
measurement_contract.percentiles: Nearest-rank on delivered samples per arm; repeated scenarios and three concurrent workers do not establish independent production significance.

pricing_snapshot.note: Official paid Jev input is $0.042/M at publication. $0.0252/M is only a hypothetical discount, not a verified official rate. Free-model scenario and paid-model scenarios are explicitly separate.

confounders: A/B prompts and visible tool sets differ by design; cannot isolate tool-schema size alone.
Three worker sessions overlap and share provider/cache load; observed cache hits are priced as reported.
Running control fixtures hold the first real child model response until the measured user request ends; pre-request setup tokens are excluded.
Visible delivery differs (A 80/90, B 86/90), so percentile differences are descriptive, not matched-quality causal speedups.
One B request timed out with incomplete usage (JV2-04-B-1); remove both sides of this case/repeat only from paired token/cost estimates.
Jev selected expected roles, but Reviewer behavior differs downstream. Context, Role/Skill selection and model behavior are possible causes; root cause is not isolated.
Technical Jev fallback, ownership, cancellation and idempotence use injected engineering tests. No natural Jev fallback occurred in the 180 primary observations.
Six follow-up scenario executions use the later admission-state context fix; do not pool them into the primary data.
No blinded semantic quality review, production capacity, real IM/Pet delivery or native package acceptance is established.

known_oracle_limitations.note: Clarification/confirmation replies were rejected by the narrow automatic regex. Original flags retained.
ReviewerCat returned blocked for missing Case/Oracle/Trace. Role selection matches expected, downstream ordinary review unmet. JV2-26-B-3 nevertheless passes the finite task oracle.
Reviewer reviewed previous-stage evidence without a fresh execution tool; the mandatory per-child tool check fails. No independent semantic pass is assigned.

excluded_diagnostic_runs.reason: Diagnostic run invalidated before acceptance; Main-error/cancellation handling was subsequently corrected.
Local proxy stale cooldown/provider errors contaminated run. Same-account upstream usage still allowed requests; proxy restart recovered original model. Do not pool with primary results.

followup.scope: Three cases (JV2-12/JV2-18/JV2-26) × A/B × one repeat after admission-state context fix; separate from primary 180.
followup.review: Manual inspection found no false dispatch-unavailable refusal in these three B samples. JV2-26-B-1 still contains a legitimate Reviewer blocked result; hard-check pass is not semantic completion.
